rules: AUTHORITATIVE CURRENT PROGRAM from 24/09/2026: exactly nine logical posts/day across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — 07:00 relationships carousel (7 cards); 09:00 survival rules carousel (9 cards); 11:00 six-sign zodiac carousel; 13:00 Dog Bartender four-card carousel; 15:00 five-card love/soul story; 17:00 fact-checked strange real phenomenon narrated video; 18:30 two-day trip in Greece narrated video; 20:00 four-card Myth or Truth; 23:00 international/foreign legend narrated video. Old 18:00 travel/phenomenon drafts are retired and never revived. All photographic/card content must use scene-relevant photographic or photorealistic visuals with readable Greek text. TikTok photo carousels use silent 1080x1080 JPEG/WebP and one platform-added music layer; no MP4 fallback for Dog Bartender. Narrated 17:00/18:30/23:00 videos are vertical 9:16 1080x1920, strictly >80s, agreed Greek male voice Νέστορας only, synchronized burned-in Greek subtitles, no background music/avatar, no filler, no long dead air. FINAL RENDER QA is mandatory: release only after PASSED_FINAL_REVIEW for visuals, voice, subtitles/sync, duration, audio, CTA, sources/licenses, platform format and duplicate checks. Any uncertainty blocks publication. No backdating/catch-up, no duplicate retries, no purchases/topups/upgrades/paid tests.

full_reset_hold.rule: Release applies only to valid current-program work. Old cancelled entries remain inactive. A future user stop/change immediately overrides this release. Configuration activation is not proof of ready or queued media.

current_nonlegacy_category_exception.dog_bartender_carousel: The 13:00 Σκύλος Μπάρμαν — ο παράξενος πελάτης four-card photo-carousel series is current approved content and must never be rejected merely because legacy dog video categories are retired.

cancelled_legacy_rule: Cancelled UUIDs are audit references only and are never gaps to revive. Reuse of underlying media is permitted only by creating a new current-program entry after fresh QA and deduplication when that exact media/content is still valid.

dog_bartender_tiktok_gate.published_success_protection: Never touch or duplicate already Published Facebook/Instagram destinations while repairing TikTok.

narrated_feature_duration_gate.failure_policy: Block before scheduling and expand substantive script/content; never use silence padding or a paid fallback.

deduplication_policy.unknown_write_result: Reconcile by live read before any retry.

history_policy.rule: Git history retains superseded configuration for audit only. Published content is not modified or republished.

final_render_qa_gate.rule: Never create or update a Metricool/social publishing entry for an unreviewed final artifact. If the final file is ugly, generic, mismatched, technically wrong, uncertain, or not directly inspected, keep it preview-only and blocked.

required_checks: no placeholders, generic mismatches or accidental repeated visuals
burned-in Greek subtitles present and synchronized when required
sources and licenses verified when applicable
platform-specific media format and audio configuration pass
hard_qa_gate.failure_policy: Do not publish, do not substitute a lower-quality fallback, and do not mark ready. Repair and re-run QA.
